thesis: Source-reported 985monitor FOMO wallet leaderboard and common-follow snapshots may contain research value only if forward-only tests survive baseline, latency, provenance, and friction controls.
null_hypothesis: The 985monitor FOMO snapshot has no monetizable or predictive research value after provenance gaps, lookahead risk, execution delay, fees, slippage, capacity, and simple baselines are applied.
time_horizon: delayed point-in-time snapshots; no live signal horizon
signal_definition: Aggregate cohort features derived from source-reported row counts, leaderboard-window persistence, common-follow buckets, wallet coverage, concentration, and provenance gaps.
expected_failure_modes: stale snapshot mistaken for live data
PnL concentration dominated by a tiny head cohort
monetization erased by latency, fees, slippage, spread, and capacity
social/common-follow context misread as coordination or identity proof
redistribution rights block commercial dataset packaging

acceptance_thresholds.point_in_time_lineage: all tested rows have source timestamp, ingest timestamp, and no future-only fields
acceptance_thresholds.leaderboard_persistence: top cohorts beat random active-wallet and volume-weighted baselines in forward-only holdouts
acceptance_thresholds.baseline_comparison: aggregate cohort edge remains positive after costs, slippage, execution delay, and capacity limits
acceptance_thresholds.concentration_stress: result does not depend on the top 10 rows or one repeated identity cohort
acceptance_thresholds.social_context_null: common-follow buckets add value beyond simple volume and activity controls without identity or coordination claims
acceptance_thresholds.provenance_rights_review: source rights and wallet-label provenance are reviewed before any external licensing

data_requirements: five CSV filenames, row counts, schemas, hashes, and source timestamp
historical snapshots with collection timestamps before any forward test
market data snapshots known at each tested timestamp
fee, slippage, spread, latency, and capacity assumptions
posthoc_edit_policy: Do not loosen thresholds, remove provenance blockers, or convert source-reported context into recommendations after observing outcomes.
